description: Plexus-style line-web visual built on the POP family. A POP point cloud (auto-generated or sourced) is fed to a Neighbor POP that fills a per-point Nebr array attribute with closest-neighbor indices. A Script SOP converts that index list into deduplicated line primitives, rendered as a Geometry COMP through a Render TOP to a Null TOP — the classic Plexus look without third-party plugins. auto_pattern: 'noise' (default) = pointgeneratorPOP + noisePOP; 'sphere' = spherePOP; 'grid' = gridPOP. count is hard-capped at 8192 (CPU O(N·k) line emission). color_mode: flat | by_distance (warm→cool gradient) | by_neighbor_count (isolation ramp). Exposes live controls: MaxDistance, MaxNeighbors, Spin, PointSize, LineAlpha. POPs are Experimental — par names and Nebr array-attribute survival through poptoSOP are probe-first unverified; result carries extra.unverified.

auto_pattern.description: Used only when source_path is undefined. noise = pointgeneratorPOP + noisePOP; sphere = spherePOP; grid = gridPOP.

color.description: Line color used directly in flat mode, as warm endpoint in by_distance, as dense endpoint in by_neighbor_count.

color_mode.description: Drives Cd attribute on the SOP. flat = single color; by_distance = per-line gradient; by_neighbor_count = per-point ramp on isolation.

count.description: Approx point count when auto-generating. Hard-capped at 8192 (line emission is O(N·k) on CPU).

expose_controls.description: Skip control panel exposure when false.

line_alpha.description: Constant MAT alpha; < 1 lets lines additively glow.

max_distance.description: Radius (POP world units) the Neighbor POP searches for neighbors. Drives Plexus density.

max_lines.description: Hard cap on emitted line primitives in the Script SOP (after dedupe).

max_neighbors.description: Per-point neighbor cap (neighborPOP.maxneighbors). Higher = denser web.

name.description: Container base name; final path uses TD auto-suffix.

parent_path.description: Parent network for the system container.

point_size.description: Optional point overlay size rendered in addition to lines. 0 hides points.

source_path.description: If set, must point to an existing POP/SOP that produces a point cloud. When omitted, a point cloud is auto-generated per auto_pattern.

spin.description: Y-axis degrees/sec spin of the whole field via Transform POP ry expression.

name: create_pop_lines_pointcloud
title: Create POP lines pointcloud (Plexus)
